The '''Kwymar sector''' was a [[sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Seelos system]].<ref name="SWR:VG:EB" /> [[Kestos Minor]], which was represented by [[Senator]] [[Ivor Drake]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars]], was also located in the sector.<ref name="Rebel Files" />
